about: Ten useful AI tips, each led by the real product. A full-bleed cover scene, then one card per tip: the real logo and tool name, the product image in a glowing mint frame, the task in two-tone capitals and three panels for what it does, where it is and who it suits. Sources, dates and image credits go in the post description.
